description: She wears an opaque teal floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and full skirt. Tan-gold knotwork borders decorate the neckline, shoulder bands, cuffs, vertical front and hem; a tan underdress shows through a modest below-knee walking opening. A tan textured wrap with teal-and-gold patterned edges rests across both forearms. An ornamental belt closes at a round knotwork buckle and has hanging round metal fittings and tassels. Round shoulder brooches, drop earrings and a small pendant necklace are visible. Brown leather shoes show beneath the hem. No headgear or weapon is visible.
